text: Attempt 19: attempt 17's mixed layout with LIGHT homes (17 and 18 both stopped near 29,000 with dense homes outrunning jobs), more factory cells, the second seaport at ~20,000, and population reminders that stop the loop so no planned step is missed.
Attempts 17 and 18 hit the same ~29,000 plateau with unemployment 11-14% and hundreds of empty dense homes. Attempt 19 goes back to light homes inside the mixed layout so jobs can keep up.
Day one (restart): dense homes with a 2x2 park in every home cell, factories, shops, coal plant, 12 river pumps, road+rail links. Audit passed.
Restarted attempt 19 on Jan 2000 after the first build landed at half scale (zoom had not taken). New plan: dense homes with parks inside every home block for land value, and a jobs-first alarm.

a20-2003 put a park on the y30 power line, cutting power to the new factory strip x110-114. Audit caught it before the clock ran. Moved the park and added a plan check that refuses parks on lines/roads.
Loan #2 (Feb 2001) and blocks 3-4: dense homes with parks, shops, factory strip x110-114.
